reviews.title: Atrocious UI
reviews.text: Has one of the worst UI designs I’ve ever come across in the App Store. Laughably bad, if not purposefully bad. The standards have never been lower.

reviews.title: Timer still doesn’t work
reviews.text: This is not difficult and yet the timer has been broken for like one year

reviews.title: Great moves, variety, and accountability!
reviews.text: The great variety and easy accountability for me. I installed the widget the daily reminders that way are game changers! I'm turning 60 next month and want to maintain and increase my mobility every day so I can keep up with our three grandchildren born this past year!

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Lousy app not worth buying. No humans displaying the exercises. I don’t like apps that use artificial characters. Just a very impersonable app. Much better options out there.

reviews.title: Great app but full of ads, even if you pay for it
reviews.text: I’ve used the app for years.  It’s improved my flexibility and is easy to follow.  Love it for that.  The GIANT downside to it, and it’s just been recent, is the placement of their own ads trying to get you to upgrade to their premium.  It’s inescapable.  You open the app and there’s a pop up.  You click out and start your routine.  You feel refreshed from your stretch but as soon as you add your stretch to your profile a massive add pops up with obnoxious music and yet another explanation of their premium membership that you are forced to listen to and watch if you want to add your stretch to your profile.  The sounds and continuous pestering to buy premium can eliminate the peace you just accomplished with your stretching.

reviews.title: ‼️SUCKS‼️
reviews.text: Not only does BEND cost money, not one comment on that point in the App reviews … I mean, ‼️WTF⁉️🤷‍♀️🤷‍♂️⁉️

reviews.title: Ridiculous limits
reviews.text: The app suffers from preventing you from doing more than one exercise a day without paying. Might as well copy it all onto paper and save the $30 a month (!?!?!?!)

reviews.title: Latest update broke the app
reviews.text: Now when I open Bend I get an ad to buy a subscription and a spinning wheel at the bottom. There is no way to get past it. I tried deleting and reinstalling, but still have the same issue. The developer website doesn’t have any contact information to submit an issue.

reviews.title: No Contact Info Anywhere
reviews.text: I joined thru an Instagram ad, and it’s not showing the subscription in the app, and there is no way to contact anyone to straighten this out.

reviews.title: Cash grab
reviews.text: Before I even finished setting up the app I was thrown into multiple screens of ‘buy now or never save’. I don’t need that kind of high pressure sales tactic before I’ve even stretched once using the app.

reviews.title: Not free app
reviews.text: Not free app , they want money

reviews.title: Can’t do anything without paying
reviews.text: After installing you spend 30mins answering questions and then find you can’t even trial any exercises without paying a monthly fee. Developers should be upfront and honest about chargers rather than wasting people’s time

reviews.title: The most boring app in the world!
reviews.text: This app is terrible, static pictures with a timer! I feel no connection with it at all, it’s really beyond boring! No sound either. Couldn’t they have shown short videos of a real human stretching? Totally unmotivating!

reviews.title: Not great for beginners
reviews.text: The pictures are very small and you get no time to study them to see what you’re supposed to be doing before the time starts. There’s no ability to adjust for any mobility or physical issues.

reviews.title: Limited
reviews.text: Honestly been using this for over 2 months now and yes there has been improvement in my mobility and flexibility however the lack of updates and adding of more stretches has you limited to the same ones in nearly every routine there is little variety and you are basically doing the same stretches in every body part they need to start updating the app regularly and adding in newer stretches so you can progress a little more each time and not stay on the same stretch

reviews.title: It’s another paid app
reviews.text:
Asks lots of questions and like many similar app tries to lure you into a subscription 

Forget it.  Use YouTube instead
